# Tox21 Phase 2 Presentation Deck (13 Slides)
**File:** `slides_phase2/tox21_phase2.pptx`
**Generated by:** `slides_phase2/build_deck.py` (python-pptx; run from `tox21-phase1/` with the venv active)
**Original author:** Abhijeet Kumar (Deliverable A5). Rebuilt from committed files in task S1.

Every result number on the slides is computed by `build_deck.py` from `results/results_test.csv`,
`results/dl_results_test_*.csv`, `results/dl_ablation_test_*.csv`, `results/dl_bootstrap_ci.csv`,
`results/best_configs_dl.json` (parameter counts, via the repo's model constructors) and the cleaned data
(`src.data.load_clean`). Speaking notes are stored in each slide's notes pane and are built from the same values.

## Slide outline

| # | Title | Content (source) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Title | Roles as in the project documents |
| 2 | Chemical context | Motivation only; no results |
| 3 | Dataset and scaffold split | Missing and positive rates computed from the data; split sizes |
| 4 | Graph construction and training | 33 atom / 6 bond features; masked weighted loss; early stopping |
| 5 | GCN and MPNN | Parameter counts from `src.dl.run.build_model` |
| 6 | H1 and H2 | H2 = XGBoost + FP-MLP (partner chosen on validation); XGBoost + H1 is secondary |
| 7 | Protocol | Freeze commit `0aebd87`, guards, what git cannot show |
| 8 | Scaffold results table | 12 rows, mean ± sample SD over seeds 0-2 (same as `tables/main_results.tex`) |
| 9 | Generalization gap | `generalization_gap.png`; descriptive only |
| 10 | H1 input ablations | `ablation_study.png`; shuffled-descriptor control |
| 11 | Architecture ablations and shuffled-label control | `dl_ablation_test_malhar.csv`; seed 2 is above the 0.55 threshold |
| 12 | Technical validation | Wilcoxon and bootstrap numbers computed in the script |
| 13 | Takeaways and limitations | Trees remain best on scaffold; H2 does not beat XGBoost |

## Typed constants (the only values not computed by the script)
- `N_TESTS_PASSED = 24`: the `make phase2-test` result observed in the S1 session.
- Slide 12 line "30 saved test-prediction files (771 x 12, finite) re-score to the committed CSV values": checked in the V1 session (task V1), not recomputed by this script.
- Slide 3 "README: 2.91% to 15.94%" per-endpoint positive rates: quoted from the repository README.
- Slide 4 "max 38.35 scaffold" (largest uncapped positive weight): from the viva drill, computed in an earlier session.
- Slide 1 team roles: taken from the previous deck and project documents; not independently checked.

## UNVERIFIED
- Why the positive-weight cap is 50, and why early stopping uses PR AUC (not recorded in the repository).
- That no test evaluation ran locally before the freeze commit.
- That the 0.55 shuffled-label threshold was set before the run; the cause of the seed-2 value is not investigated.
- "Phase 1 baselines were not re-tuned" is carried over from the previous deck and the methods text.
- The deck was rendered with LibreOffice only, not opened in PowerPoint.
